title: Open Logic Project — Türkçe: 722 modülün tamamı / All 722 modules in the Turkish reader
description:
Türkçe: 722 modülün tamamı tek okuyucuda / All 722 modules in one Turkish reader — 1,198 pages.

Önceki PDF’de olmayan 80 modül, metinleri, kanıtları, alıştırmaları ve kural tablolarıyla okuyucuya eklenmiştir. Bu çeviriler zaten kaynak paketinde bulunuyordu.

The previous reader covered 642 of the 722 translated modules. This correction includes the other 80 in the PDF, with stable OLP identifiers and bookmarks. It preserves the original Turkish target bodies and does not claim to complete proofs unfinished in the frozen English source.

The exact 6,200,006-byte PDF passed local build, source-preservation, text/link and visual checks: 904 bookmarks, 3,172 internal links, zero broken internal links. SHA-256: 4af08c16e61aa058500cc1e96acb5d700c988718a729d4d6cbbe4aea9664df94. These checks concern the PDF itself; publication is recorded separately.

The source/provenance ZIPs are privacy-safe derivatives. In 48 metadata/log entries, the case-insensitive private profile identifier becomes [maintainer]. Every other entry byte and all entry names are preserved; all 722 translated target bodies match their frozen closure hashes. The correction ZIP includes per-entry original/derivative hashes and the privacy rationale. Historical public versions remain unchanged.

Frozen source: Open Logic Project commit 9620cc73f9c8e0ad003c514a5d3748f29611c4c0. This is Turkish, not Inter-Turkic.

Stable Turkish concept DOI; previous 642-module reader; GitHub repository.
